title: Secure automation for cost-optimizer: RBAC, change approvals, and immutable audit trail for auto-apply/rollback
creator: Priya Patel
description: Add production-grade security and change-management controls for the Cost Optimization Automation service (recommendations + auto-apply/rollback) so automated batching/caching changes can be applied safely in customer environments and recorded for audits. This ticket covers: RBAC model for who can enable auto-apply, approval workflows for production applies, immutable audit logging integration (SIEM/Kafka), and a verified rollback protocol (timed canary, idempotent revert, proof-of-change). Includes implementation design, PRs, E2E tests, and runbook updates.
acceptance_criteria: A1: RBAC roles defined and enforced in Control Plane: view, recommend, approve, auto-apply, emergency-revert
A2: All auto-applies require a scoped approval token or approval policy when targeting Dedicated/Private deployments
A3: Every config apply/rollback emits an immutable audit record with: requestor, approver, policy id, diff, timestamp, and revert token
A4: Auto-apply can be scoped to staging/canary groups with automatic rollback windows and health checks
A5: Security team sign-off (security_review_required) recorded in ticket and Confluence approvals
implementation_plan: Design RBAC model and map to existing IAM (roles + attributes). Proposal: add CostOptimizer.Admin, CostOptimizer.Approver, CostOptimizer.Operator, CostOptimizer.Readonly
Introduce an Approval Service: short-lived approval tokens tied to a change request; integrates w/ SSO and email/Slack approvals
Extend Apply API to accept: change_request_id, approver_token, canary_policy_id, and revert_deadline
Emit audit events to immutable log stream (write-once Kafka topic with retention+append-only config) and mirror to customer-managed SIEM for Private customers
Implement safe-apply middleware: validate dry-run, simulate token/cost delta, run canary on subset, monitor QoS metrics (latency/regression), and trigger rollback on thresholds
Implement idempotent rollback operation producing a signed revert token and a reversible diff in audit log
Add enforcement tests, unit and integration tests; update runtime config-permissions matrix and console UI with role selectors
testing_plan: Unit tests for RBAC checks and approval token verification
Integration tests: simulated apply -> canary -> auto-rollback when latency > threshold
Chaos test: revoked approver credentials and ensure apply fails gracefully
E2E test: Concourse pipeline test against a staging Dedicated cluster with observability hooks
Security tests: tamper attempts against audit stream, ensure append-only behavior and alerting
rollback_strategy: Primary rollback: automatic revert triggered by health checks within the revert_deadline
Manual rollback: Approver with emergency-revert role can invoke immediate rollback via Console or API
Staged rollback: roll back canary subset first, then progressively to full population if issues persist
Fail-safe: if audit-write fails, block auto-apply and escalate to on-call with reason code
audit_requirements: Audit records must include diffs (unified diff), who requested, who approved, approval method, target scope, and PK of config version
Records must be write-once and cryptographically signed before replication to external SIEM
Retention: default 1 year in Control Plane; customer-configurable for Private deployments
Expose audit search API with RBAC-filtered results and export for compliance audits
